sources.authority: Brief sets batch scope and cover direction. Ian's Visual Direction sets lane treatments. Brand-book recommendation supplies exact palette and typography. Jerami adopted these as production direction with the shared 10% allowance; separate client sign-off is not claimed.

client.name: Pastor Ben

batch.inventoryAuthority: Brief's requested count and average; not a verified source-file count or target duration.
batch.scope: One branded cover per finished video. Static images, carousels and quote cards are excluded.
batch.routing: Inspect each source's subject before selecting a lane. Camera format alone does not settle teaching versus reflective faith content. Family and music rules do not add deliverables to the 14-video batch.

references.inspection: Links resolved from Ian's document in the earlier source audit. Full reference-account and embedded-image visual audit remains pending.
references.placeholderPolicy: Use Ben's approved source frame and the video's own headline. Brand-book portraits, example hooks and scripture labels are examples, not reusable client assets.

brand.paletteName: Modern Earth with Quiet Reflective blue accent

typography.weightAuthority: No exact weights or pixel sizes supplied. Record the measured lane baseline after the sample.

brand.fontStatus: Cambria pending per Jerami. Do not purchase, install from an unlicensed source, or silently substitute it. Verify Calibri availability before use.
brand.colorUse: Black/olive editorial base, brown for warmth, cream for calm surfaces, gray-blue for reflective faith and ADHD content. Preserve natural skin and footage; graphic palette is not a global color tint.

rules: Prioritize natural footage and Ben's presence over heavy graphics.
Keep the Modern Earth palette consistent, with the recommended gray-blue accent.
Use editorial serif moments intentionally for teaching or reflection. Body text stays clean and readable.
The page feels lived-in and human. Keep family and music distinct within Ben's system.
Avoid heavy overlays, oversized bold text on every post, generic Christian graphics and John-style treatments.

coverDirection.headline: A clear, bold headline that reads at a glance.
coverDirection.image: Use an approved still or photo of Pastor Ben.
coverDirection.consistency: Recognizable grid treatment using Ben's own palette.
coverDirection.distinction: Bold cover hierarchy does not require heavy video overlays or oversized bold text throughout each edit. Reflective, family and music lanes keep their quieter treatment.

productionStatus.limits: JSON and hook checks validate enrollment and declared adjustment bounds. They do not certify rendered style alignment.

teaching.name: Talking Head / Teaching
teaching.treatment: Clean and simple. Minimal text. Strong hook/title only when needed. Ben remains the focal point.
teaching.labelAuthority: No mandatory series label or fixed title copy is supplied.

visualPasses.framing: Ben remains the focal point in 9:16. Keep the face clear; use his actual footage.
visualPasses.color: Natural, grounded picture. Modern Earth supports the graphics without a heavy tint.
visualPasses.opening: No mandatory intro card. A short hook/title over footage is optional, only when needed. Duration is an editorial default to measure in the sample.
visualPasses.onScreenText: Minimal text. Use Cambria for an intentional editorial heading and Calibri for body text when available. Avoid oversized bold overlays on every post.
visualPasses.cover: Approved Ben still plus a clear, bold headline, with Modern Earth colors and readable hierarchy. Exact geometry is unmeasured.

visualReview: Bold cover headline readable on phone
Native captions absent from the clean Opus master

faith.name: Faith / Scripture
faith.treatment: More editorial and reflective. Calm compositions, serif typography, cream/olive/gray-blue tones.
faith.labelAuthority: No fixed scripture label is required. Include a verse reference only when the source supports it.

visualPasses.framing: Calm 9:16 composition with room for a short editorial heading; Ben stays visible when on camera.
visualPasses.color: Cream, olive and gray-blue graphics support reflection. Keep source skin and footage natural.
visualPasses.opening: No mandatory intro card. Use a restrained reflective heading only when it adds needed context.
visualPasses.onScreenText: Intentional Cambria serif heading with readable Calibri body. Keep scripture copy attributable to the source.
visualPasses.cover: Ben's approved still and a clear headline with calmer cream/olive/gray-blue hierarchy. Do not copy the brand book's placeholder scripture or person.

family.name: Family / Everyday
family.treatment: Very natural. Little to no graphic treatment. Warm grade and candid framing.
family.batchScope: Reference lane only until a source in the current 14-video batch is verified to fit. No added family deliverables.

visualPasses.framing: Candid 9:16 framing. Preserve the people and everyday setting in the source.
visualPasses.color: Warm, natural grade. Do not force teaching-card colors over family footage.
visualPasses.opening: No mandatory intro card or recurring label. Let the source moment open the video.
visualPasses.onScreenText: Little to no graphics. Any necessary hook stays short and readable.
visualPasses.cover: Ben's approved candid frame carries the cover. Keep any headline simple within his palette; do not turn it into a heavy teaching card.

music.name: Music
music.treatment: More cinematic and mood-led. Darker imagery is fine. Keep text minimal and let performance create the energy.
music.batchScope: Reference lane only until a source in the current 14-video batch is verified to fit. No added music deliverables.

visualPasses.framing: Performance-led 9:16 composition with Ben as the subject. Preserve meaningful performance details.
visualPasses.color: Darker imagery is allowed when supported by the source. Keep the Modern Earth identity; do not force a dark grade onto unsuitable footage.
visualPasses.opening: No mandatory intro card. Let performance establish the opening energy.
visualPasses.onScreenText: Minimal text; intentional editorial type only when needed. No persistent heavy overlays.
visualPasses.cover: Approved performance still with a minimal title and Ben's palette. Performance carries the visual energy.
